title: Pure Helios
summary: The Helios archetype embodies Professor Banner's alchemical mastery over the banish zone through Helios - The Primordial Sun and Macro Cosmos. Supported by Chaos Distill, which banishes sent cards while searching Macro Cosmos and your bosses, the deck continually grows Helios Duo Megistus, Helios Trice Megistus, and Golden Homunculus to astronomical ATK values. Paired with Grand Convergence for complete board wipes and Pot of Desires to instantly fuel thousands of bonus stats, the deck crushes opponents beneath overwhelming banish power.

allow.Gren Maju Da Eiza: Level 3 FIRE Fiend companion that gains 400 ATK/DEF for each of your banished cards alongside Helios and Golden Homunculus.
allow.Eater of Millions: Banishes 5+ cards face-down from your Extra Deck to Special Summon itself, instantly adding ATK to Helios, Golden Homunculus, and Gren Maju while banishing any monster it battles.
allow.Pot of Desires: Banishes 10 cards from the top of your Deck face-down to draw 2 cards, immediately giving Golden Homunculus and Helios Trice Megistus +3000 ATK and Gren Maju +4000 ATK!
allow.Dimensional Fissure: Continuous Spell that acts as copies 7-9 of Macro Cosmos by banishing any monster sent to the GY.
allow.Trap Trick: Banishes 1 Macro Cosmos from your Deck to Set a 2nd Macro Cosmos directly to your field that can be activated the same turn to summon Helios - The Primordial Sun!
allow.Infernal Flame Banshee: Rank 4 Pyro Xyz that can be summoned using two Level 4 Helios - The Primordial Sun to search another Helios Pyro monster, and revives itself when banished while you control a Pyro monster.

main: Helios - The Primordial Sun
Level 4 LIGHT Pyro (? ATK / ? DEF): Special Summoned directly from your hand or Deck whenever Macro Cosmos is activated; gains 100 ATK/DEF for each banished monster.
Helios Duo Megistus

Level 6 LIGHT Pyro (? ATK / ? DEF): searchable by Chaos Distill; can be Special Summoned from hand by Tributing 1 Helios - The Primordial Sun, gains 200 ATK/DEF per banished monster, and revives itself during the End Phase with +300 ATK/DEF if destroyed by battle!
Helios Trice Megistus

Level 8 LIGHT Pyro boss (? ATK / ? DEF): searchable by Chaos Distill; Special Summons itself by Tributing Helios Duo Megistus, gains 300 ATK/DEF per banished monster, attacks a second time if the opponent controls a monster, and revives itself with +500 ATK/DEF if destroyed by battle!
Golden Homunculus
Amnael's Level 6 LIGHT Warrior boss (1500 base ATK/DEF) that gains 300 ATK and DEF for EACH of your banished cards—reaching 4500 ATK/DEF after a single Pot of Desires!
Gren Maju Da Eiza
Gains 400 ATK/DEF for each of your banished cards, pairing with Macro Cosmos, Chaos Distill, and Pot of Desires for 4000–8000 ATK beatdown.
Eater of Millions
Banishes 5 to 15 Extra Deck cards face-down to Special Summon itself, fueling Helios, Golden Homunculus, and Gren Maju.
Chaos Distill

Core Continuous Spell: banishes any card sent to your GY, searches Macro Cosmos or Grand Convergence from your Deck, and banishes itself while Macro Cosmos is on the field to search Helios - The Primordial Sun, Helios Duo Megistus, or Helios Trice Megistus!
Macro Cosmos
Signature Continuous Trap: when activated, Special Summons 1 'Helios - The Primordial Sun' directly from your hand or Deck, and banishes any card sent to the GY while face-up.
Grand Convergence
Signature Quick-Play Spell: while you control Macro Cosmos, inflicts 300 damage to your opponent and destroys ALL monsters on the field!
Dimensional Fissure
Continuous Spell that banishes any monster sent to the GY, fueling Helios and Golden Homunculus.
Pot of Desires
Banishes 10 cards from your Deck to draw 2 cards and add +3000/+4000 ATK to your bosses.
Trap Trick
Banishes 1 Macro Cosmos from your Deck to Set another Macro Cosmos that can be activated immediately on the same turn.
extra: Rank 4 Pyro Xyz that can be summoned using two Level 4 Helios - The Primordial Sun to search another Helios Pyro monster, and revives itself with bonus ATK when banished while you control a Pyro monster.
